name: Charity accounting keyboard and data-entry accessibility layer
demand: The regulated population is broad but not a measure of demand for this add-on: the England and Wales register had 171,112 charities on 31 March 2026; OSCR reported 24,946 charities in Scotland for April–June 2026; CCNI says its register displays over 7,500 charities. These registers can overlap, so I have not summed them. Paxton customer count, extension installs, and keyword search volumes are unverified. The Trustpilot page shows 27 reviews, not 27 users; the single supplied keyboard complaint is self-reported and gets zero weight under your rule. Sources: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/charity-commission-annual-report-and-accounts-2025-to-2026/charity-commission-annual-report-and-accounts-2025-to-2026 ; https://www.oscr.org.uk/news/new-sector-overview-report-shows-scottish-charity-sector-remains-steady/ ; https://prd-ccni.pplprojects.co.uk/start-up-a-charity/register-of-charities/ ; https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/paxtoncharities.co.uk
prices: Paxton Standard: £50/month plus VAT; Advanced: £75/month plus VAT. Data Developments MyFundAccounting: £15/month including VAT, plus £4 per additional licence. Andica Charity Accounts: from £100/year excluding VAT. Aedon.Charities: £145/month per full user and £40/month per reviewer, with 10 Salesforce cloud licences included; VAT treatment is not stated on the cited page. These are accounting products, not direct keyboard-layer comparables; a direct add-on price is unverified. Sources: https://paxtonsoftware.co.uk/pricing/ ; https://www.datadevelopments.co.uk/solutions/myfundaccounting ; https://andica.com/andica-charity-software-cloud.html ; https://aedon.co/

revenue_proof.claim: No qualifying revenue proof found. The Trustpilot reviewer describes using Paxton and a keyboard-navigation complaint, but states no subscription status or payment amount; this is not evidence of revenue for the proposed add-on.

copy_speed: A basic browser overlay looks easy to imitate: Chrome documents content scripts that can read and change a webpage DOM. No Paxton-specific keyboard add-on surfaced in this search. Adjacent signals since April 2026: Andica announced a Charity Accounts product release on 13 May 2026; the generic OneKey Navigator Firefox extension was updated on 12 August 2026 and showed 1 user, but it is not an accounting form-navigation fix. These are not direct competitors. Sources: https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/develop/concepts/content-scripts ; https://andica.com/news.html ; https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/onekey-navigator/
platform_risk: Paxton offers both a cloud version and Windows desktop software, so a browser extension would not cover the desktop users. Whether the cloud client exposes a normal, modifiable webpage DOM is unverified; Paxton's public documentation reviewed here does not describe an API or third-party integration. Paxton's January 2026 support blog documents Space-to-edit grid fields, paste actions, and F9 copy-line actions, but does not document a fix for the reported Tab gaps. A Paxton UI change could break screen-specific selectors. Sources: https://paxtonsoftware.co.uk/paxton-products/paxton-charity-accounting-software ; https://paxtonsoftware.co.uk/support/documentation ; https://paxtonsoftware.co.uk/support/support-blog ; https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/develop/concepts/content-scripts
defensible_asset: No strong moat is evidenced. The proposed layer does not need its own UK charity rules engine, and it would not own the accounting ledger or create much switching cost; that is an inference from the product scope. A tested map of Paxton screens and a regression suite could help, but would be easy for Paxton to reproduce and would need maintenance. Sources: https://paxtonsoftware.co.uk/paxton-products/paxton-charity-accounting-software ; https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/develop/concepts/content-scripts
build_effort: A no-backend browser proof of concept is technically plausible because Chrome content scripts can inspect and modify DOM elements. Production effort is unverified: first confirm that Paxton's cloud client exposes those elements, then map and regression-test each supported entry screen, browser, and keyboard interaction. The Windows desktop edition is outside browser-extension scope. Chrome also requires narrow permissions and disclosure of user-data handling; finance and form data count as user data under its policy. No estimate for solo delivery or ongoing support is evidenced. Sources: https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/develop/concepts/content-scripts ; https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/develop/concepts/declare-permissions ; https://developer.chrome.com/docs/webstore/program-policies/user-data-faq ; https://paxtonsoftware.co.uk/pricing/
channel: Use exact-match SEO for Paxton keyboard-navigation searches and a Chrome Web Store listing, then offer demos through opt-in charity-finance communities or partner newsletters. Do not rely on cold email, SMS, WhatsApp, or social DMs to individuals or sole traders: ICO guidance treats social direct messages as electronic mail and requires consent for unsolicited marketing to individual subscribers, including sole traders. Sources: https://support.google.com/accessibility/answer/7040464?hl=en ; https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/direct-marketing-and-privacy-and-electronic-communications/guide-to-pecr/electronic-and-telephone-marketing/electronic-mail-marketing/
owner_hours_per_week: Unverified; the <=5 hours/week limit cannot be substantiated before compatibility and support needs are measured. Screen changes and user-specific support could add recurring work.
desk_test: Within one day, request Paxton's free trial and use dummy data to check whether the reported Tab gap still occurs in a real cloud workflow. If it does, make a local-only Chrome content-script prototype for that one form and record a short before/after demo. Share it through an opt-in charity-finance channel and seek a paid pilot commitment before building a product. Stop if the gap cannot be reproduced or no prospective user will commit to a pilot. Paxton advertises a free trial; Chrome documents local content-script development. Sources: https://paxtonsoftware.co.uk/pricing/ ; https://paxtonsoftware.co.uk/support/documentation ; https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/develop/concepts/content-scripts
red_flags: The 50% automation figure is a target required by your constraint, not a measured result. The <=5 hours/week limit is also unverified. The only specific demand signal is a self-reported 7 October 2025 complaint; payment is unverified and the complaint has zero weight under your failure-evidence rule. Paxton's published support tips already address some keyboard and paste tasks, though not the reported Tab gaps. Paxton's product page describes monthly rolling contracts, while its online terms state a one-calendar-year minimum; reconcile this discrepancy before relying on churn assumptions. Sources: https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/paxtoncharities.co.uk ; https://paxtonsoftware.co.uk/support/support-blog ; https://paxtonsoftware.co.uk/paxton-products/paxton-charity-accounting-software ; https://paxtonsoftware.co.uk/terms-conditions
